description: The outcome of a reindex request.

outcome.description: plan: a dry run; no run was created. created: a new run was queued. unchanged: the target already matches the active profile. already_live: a run is already in progress. lock_contended: another create holds the single-flight lock; retry.

run_id.description: The run id, present for created and already_live.

estimated_items.description: The number of items the new geometry must embed.

estimated_tags.description: The number of tags the new geometry must embed.
